# sigil-ui

> Svelte 5 (runes) component library. CSS framework agnostic: every component
> consumes the --sig-* CSS variable contract and merges a class prop, so
> Tailwind v4, UnoCSS, Panda CSS or plain CSS can theme it. Zero runtime
> component dependencies. Machine-readable metadata: /manifest.json.

## Docs

- [Full component docs](llms-full.txt): props, classes, data attributes, examples
- [Token contract](#tokens): every --sig-* variable with light and dark defaults
- [Component manifest](manifest.json): structured JSON for agents

## Components

- Button: Button with variant styling driven by data-variant and the --sig-* token contract.
- Badge: Inline status label.
- Switch: Toggle using role=switch and aria-checked.
- Input: Styled native text input.
- Select: Styled native select with a chevron affordance.
- Checkbox: Styled native checkbox.
- Avatar: Round avatar with image and initials fallback.
- Progress: Progress bar with role=progressbar and aria value wiring.
- Skeleton: Loading placeholder block with a pulse animation.
- Alert: Inline message with tone colors.
- Separator: Horizontal or vertical rule.
- Stat: Dashboard metric: uppercase label, large value, optional signed delta colored by direction.
- Tooltip: Hover and focus tooltip.
- Card: Surface namespace: Root, Header, Title, Description, Content, Footer.
- Tabs: Tabs namespace: Root (bindable value), List, Trigger, Content.
- Accordion: Accordion namespace: Root, Item (value), Trigger, Content.
- Dialog: Modal dialog namespace: Root (bindable open), Trigger, Portal, Overlay, Content, Title, Description, Close.
- Toaster: Toast system.
- PaneGroup: Resizable split panes (PaneGroup, Pane, PaneResizer).
- Textarea: Styled native textarea with bindable value and invalid state.
- RadioGroup: RadioGroup namespace: Root (bindable value, roving tabindex, arrow keys) and Item (role=radio, aria-checked).
- Slider: Styled native range input with bindable value and filled track via a --sig-slider-pct custom property.
- Toggle: Pressed/unpressed button with aria-pressed and data-state.
- Kbd: Keyboard key cap for shortcuts and hints.
- Breadcrumb: Breadcrumb namespace: Root renders nav + ol with aria-label, Item renders li with auto slash separators and aria-current on the last entry.
- Popover: Popover namespace: Root (bindable open), Trigger (aria-haspopup=dialog), Content (anchored, side/align).
- DropdownMenu: Menu namespace: Root (bindable open), Trigger (aria-haspopup=menu), Content (role=menu, arrow keys, Home/End), Item (role=menuitem, onSelect), Separator.
- Empty: Empty state block with dashed border, optional icon snippet, title, description, and action slot.
- Measure: Dev tool: wraps content, shows a live pixel size badge driven by ResizeObserver, and passes width/height to children snippet props.
- GridOverlay: Dev tool: fixed overlay that draws a spacing grid and can outline elements whose content leaks or clips.
- Spinner: Loading indicator with role=status and an aria-label.
- Field: Form field wrapper: label, control, hint and error with generated id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid wiring.
- Table: Table namespace: Root (scroll wrapper + table), Head, Body, Row, H, Cell, Caption.
- Sheet: Sheet namespace: Root (bind:open), Trigger, Portal, Overlay, Content (side: left/right/top/bottom), Title, Description, Close.
- Chart: Chart namespace: Line, Bar, Sparkline and Donut.
- DataTable: Sortable data table.
- CountUp: Animated number transition driven by requestAnimationFrame with an easeOutCubic curve.
- Pagination: Page navigation in a nav landmark.
- CopyButton: Copy text to the clipboard with a textarea fallback.
- Reveal: Scroll-into-view reveal via IntersectionObserver.
- ScrollArea: Scrollable container with thin custom scrollbars.
- Command: Command palette namespace: Root (bindable value, filter, loop), Input (role=combobox), List, Item (role=option, keywords, onSelect), Group (heading), Empty, Separator, Dialog (mod+k modal).
- Combobox: Autocomplete namespace: Root (bindable value and open, filter), Input (role=combobox, aria-activedescendant), Content (role=listbox), Item (role=option), Empty.
- ContextMenu: Right-click menu namespace: Root (opens at pointer, bindable open), Content (role=menu, viewport clamped), Item (role=menuitem, onSelect), Separator.

## Adapters

- Tailwind CSS v4: sigil-ui/tailwind.css
- UnoCSS: sigil-ui/uno
- Panda CSS: sigil-ui/panda
- No framework: sigil-ui/theme.css
- sigil css: sigil-ui/css

## Install

```
pnpm add sigil-ui
import 'sigil-ui/theme.css'
```
